methodology: Isolated Chrome contexts at requested CSS viewports. Text is temporarily hidden with visibility without changing layout to sample the actual composited background under every rendered text rectangle. Foreground color and opacity are measured before masking. Image framing geometry and source scaling are reported; architecture anchors require visual inspection. All writes and external services are blocked or replaced with fixtures. External font stylesheets are replaced by empty fixtures, so screenshots use installed fallback fonts. OIDC, when supplied, is attached only to the deployment origin and is never persisted.
